To examine **The Cinder-Wrought Aegis** (the relic borne by Cerys Sablewood the Ashen since 356 AS [1]), one must journey to **Vharencrag Fortress**, where the relic was recorded in the field report [2]. (If conveyance of the relic is required under contract, it is to be taken to **Embercrag Fortress** in the Shattered Vale [3]).

**Sources:** [1], [2], [3]
